messages:
Tess (People Ops): Heads-up — the city transit union announced a 24-hour commuter strike on Nov 3. To keep people safe and productive, SF hub will run on a staggered start and limited-capacity shuttle service. Read the plan and RSVP if you need a guaranteed seat.

Marcus (Logistics): If you normally take public transit, we recommend using the shuttle or claiming a ride credit. Weve budgeted ride credits and a small parking expansion for that day.

Diego (Eng): Staggered start? My team usually sync at 9am.

Tess (People Ops): Staggered start: building opens at 08:00. Suggested in-office windows: 08:30-12:30 or 12:30-17:30 to spread demand. If you must be there for a 9am sync, book a shuttle seat or request Manager approval for an exception.

Noor (Security): Access note: external doors will be manned from 07:45-09:30 and 12:15-13:00 to manage foot traffic. Badge access otherwise as normal.

FacilitiesBot: Shuttle plan (SF hub) — reserve via DeskReserve -> "Strike Shuttle" tag:
```
Nov 3 (Strike Day):
AM runs: 07:15 / 08:00 / 08:45 (pickup: Civic Garage, Downtown Station, Marina Stop)
PM runs: 17:00 / 17:45 / 18:30 (return same stops)
Capacity: 18 pax per run; book early
```
Note: there will be one accessible shuttle (wheelchair ramp).

Marcus (Logistics): Commute vouchers: if you cant use the shuttle and need a rideshare, file for the "Strike Ride Credit" in expenses. Eligible staff get up to $50 round-trip (in-city) or $80 if coming from outside the metro area. Receipts required.

Diego (Eng): What about parking? I drive in sometimes and dont have a permit.

Marcus (Logistics): Temporary parking: Civic Garage has 40 reserved spots (first-come, register on the parking page). If youre coming by car and need a spot, register by Nov 1. If full, carpool or use ride credit.

Tess (People Ops): Food: well have two food trucks on-site 11:30-13:30 (tacos + bowls). If youre working remote that day and miss lunch, you can claim a $12 meal stipend. Add dietary needs on the RSVP.

Noor (Security): Guests: no external guests allowed during the strike due to limited capacity. Partner vendors with essential visits must be pre-cleared by Facilities.

Diego (Eng): Remote folks — are they marked as excused? I have an on-call rotation that day.

Tess (People Ops): Remote is allowed. Managers: be flexible. On-call staff are expected to follow normal plans; if youre on-call and cant get to the office, coordinate with your manager for coverage. Log exceptions on the People Ops portal.

CalendarBot: Event updated "SF Transit Strike - Nov 3: Shuttle & Commute Plan" by Tess. RSVP: https://intranet.redwood/office-events/1793456789

Tess (People Ops): TL;DR: Nov 3 transit strike — staggered in-office windows, reserve shuttle seats (DeskReserve), ride credits available up to $80, limited temporary parking (register by Nov 1), no external guests, food trucks on-site, remote allowed. Ping People Ops or Facilities if you need accessibility or childcare support. :bus: :oncoming_automobile:
